summary: Guinea-Bissau’s conservation pledge seeks an approximately 40% reduction in LULUCF-sector emissions relative to the baseline scenario by 2030. Its agriculture commitments aim to improve dairy-cow productivity by 10%, shorten the rice-field watering period from 183 days in the reference scenario to 165 days in 2030, and reduce agricultural emissions by 4% from the reference scenario by 2030. For perspective, forest covers 72.4% of the country and agriculture 24.4%; accordingly, these pledges focus on emissions and production practices affecting the country’s dominant land-cover classes, rather than setting hectare-based restoration, conservation, or sustainable-farming area targets.

targets.context: Forest covers 72.4% of the country, but the target concerns emissions rather than forest area.
Agriculture covers 24.4% of the country; the affected herd area is not specified.
The targeted rice-field area is not specified.
Agriculture covers 24.4% of the country; the emissions target has no stated area denominator.
